messages:
anya (People Ops): Hey all — quick follow-up from today's All‑Hands. A few people asked about travel + satellite office visits + desk hoteling. I'll collect answers here so it's easy to reference. Main questions: 1) reimbursing rides (Uber/taxi) for satellite office travel, 2) desk reservation rules at hubs/satellites, 3) any near-term offsite dates to pencil in?

mike (Eng): For rides — do we have a limit per trip / per day? also curious about Lyft XL for teams with gear.

josh (CTO): Short answer: rides are reimbursable with itemized receipt, use Concur/Expensify and code as "Travel - Ground". Policy cap is $75 per one-way in metro areas unless pre-approved. For larger vehicles (XL/vans) get manager pre-approval — reasonable if moving equipment. International/local nuance: for cross-border travel we require pre-approval from People Ops. Full policy here: https://redwood.internal/policies/travel (link)

anya (People Ops): To add — if you expect to exceed the cap, put a quick note in the expense pre-approval workflow (People Ops will triage). Receipts are required; screenshots of ride receipts are fine.

lina (Finance): Expensing tip: please set the "project" field to your team code and the "expense_type" to team:travel. If booking with corporate card, mark as "corporate"; otherwise personal + reimburse. We try to turn around reimbursements within 5 business days.

sarah (Design): Desk hoteling — are we keeping the existing 7-day window or moving back to open booking? lots of teams want predictable spots for collab days.

ted (Facilities): Desk policy update: hubs will keep hoteling (no assigned desks) but we are locking long-term holds. Reservations open 7 days prior to visit, max 3 concurrent days reserved per user in a 14-day window. No more multi-week holds. This helps fairness as we get busier on weekdays. Booking tool: https://redwood.booking.internal (internal).

mike (Eng): That makes sense. Will any teams get recurring exceptions for heavy in-office days?

anya (People Ops): Managers can request recurring exceptions for mission-critical roles via the office-exceptions form (link above). We review monthly and prioritize project needs.

josh (CTO): Offsites: product org offsite is tentatively mid-July (firm date pending). Company-wide offsite targeted for Q4 — still exploratory. Ask managers to hold off on heavy travel plans around those windows for now. We'll publish firm dates by end of next sprint.

calendar-bot: Note: created provisional 2-day "Product Offsite (Tentative)" event for Jul 14-15 on company calendar — RSVP optional.

sarah (Design): Are there plans for a shuttle or travel stipend for the product offsite? some folks coming from outside SF/SEA.

ted (Facilities): For product offsite we're exploring a subsidized shuttle from SFO and a capped travel stipend for remote teammates. Final logistics will be in the offsite ops doc (we'll share a link once approved).

lina (Finance): If a stipend is approved, it will be processed as a one-time reimbursement. We'll publish guidance on allowable items (fares, single-night hotels for red-eye mitigation, etc.).

mike (Eng): Thanks — last q: any etiquette for hybrid days when team has in-person collab? e.g., prioritize in-person for sprint kickoff?

anya (People Ops): Great question — recommended practice is: teams should agree at the start of the sprint. For cross-team collab days, teams are encouraged to publish a "collab day" on shared calendar and request desks for those days (use booking tool). People Ops can help coordinate cross-team days if multiple teams want the same week.

josh (CTO): +1 from leadership — pragmatic approach: when a team schedules core in-person work, please give 72 hours notice on the team channel so folks can plan.

anya (People Ops): I'll follow up with a short FAQ thread and links to the booking form, pre-approval workflow, and travel policy. Thanks for the quick replies, team :thumbsup:

mike (Eng): Awesome, thanks.

sarah (Design): Thanks!

ted (Facilities): Will post capacity/sketch for SF hub tomorrow.

lina (Finance): Will add expense coding examples to the FAQ.

anya (People Ops): Closing: I'll update the People Ops wiki and ping managers when the offsite dates are firm. If you have individual exceptions, DM me or use the form.
